schema_note: Ahmed Al-Ghamdi Raṣāʾif bibliography (25–29 works on the 2026 GitHub Pages corpus). Discovery index only: we do not ingest his parallel CSV or Typesense dump. His cite page says the interface is MIT and the texts remain their owners'; files are for non-commercial research. Many rasaif-aligned English editions are modern scholarly translations (Rosenthal, LAL, Penguin, Brill, SUNY). Same trap as ATHAR. Hunt PD editions separately. Never stamp public from this file.
